note: Waygates, the arches of the Old Roads (roadmap: gates; core/game/game_gates.gd, ui/play/gate_art.gd, ui/play/gate_panel.gd; design in docs/GATES.md; checked by tools/check_data.gd). A gate stands at a fixed place, a pure function of the seed (`anchor`: an offset from a place's anchor, or a realm's nominal tile; the nearest valid ground is taken). It has one rune slot for each rune of `runes` (`sizes` gives the count for its size); each slot is whole, worn, broken or stripped, a pure function of the seed, the gate, the slot and the world year (`whole` slots start whole, the rest are dealt by `start_split`; wear is `wear` a year times the rune's own rate, thieves strip a slot with silver at `theft_chance` a year times the gate's `exposure`). Repairs (`repair`: silver and gold, scaled by `size_cost`, the rune's `cost` and the generation) are the only thing saved. A gate with no broken or stripped slots (`dark_at`) works: lit if every slot is whole, flickering (a charge, `charge`, for each trip) if some are worn. A `networks` list says which gates it links; a realm gate (`realm`) is a door to that realm and sets its `gate_<realm>` flag once repaired.

road.name: Road
road.lore: The Old Road remembers the foot that walks it. Cut it first, for every arch begins with a road.

door.name: Door
door.lore: A door is a promise that there is another side.

bind.name: Bind
bind.lore: What the arch joins, the bind holds. Without it the far gate is only a rumour.

light.name: Light
light.lore: The lamp-rune. Silver drinks the light of the day and gives it back as the arch wakes.

return.name: Return
return.lore: No traveller is let through who has no road home. This rune is that road.

ward.name: Ward
ward.lore: The ward keeps the arch from taking more than it was given.

deep.name: Deep
deep.lore: The deep-rune reaches under the world, where the far doors are kept.

bough.name: Bough
bough.lore: A bent branch, the key of the green court. Sap runs where the silver is thin.

barrow.name: Barrow
barrow.lore: A mound with a door cut in it: the key of the Hollow Below.

wing.name: Wing
wing.lore: Three strokes and a curl: the key of the isles in the high air.

ember.name: Ember
ember.lore: A flame that does not climb: the key of the planes of fire, stone, tide and wind.

cog.name: Cog
cog.lore: A wheel with one tooth worn: the key of the Expanse that keeps its own hours.

dream.name: Dream
dream.lore: A closed eye, drawn open: the key of the Dreaming.

void.name: Void
void.lore: A ring with nothing in it. The books say to cut it last and to cut it well.

gates.name: Hearthmere Arch
gates.about: The arch the carters call the Lamplighter, a stone's throw outside the east wall.

gates.name: Ironford Arch
gates.about: Where the king's road and the wild road cross, so the arch is kept up.

gates.name: Kingshold Arch
gates.about: The great arch south of the capital. Its silver is the first thing a thief thinks of.

gates.name: Brinehaven Arch
gates.about: Salt has eaten what the thieves left.

gates.name: Greenvale Arch
gates.about: An arch in a meadow of broken columns.

gates.name: Whisperwood Arch
gates.about: Roots have lifted the footings; the trees lean away from it.

gates.name: Elderglade Arch
gates.about: The smallest arch of the Old Road, in a ring of elder trees.

gates.name: Frostreach Arch
gates.about: Rime fills every cut rune, so it is hard to tell the whole from the broken.

gates.name: Highcrag Arch
gates.about: The greatest arch of the Old Road, and the most ruined.

gates.name: Verdant Gate
gates.about: A door to another world, and its lock.

gates.name: Hollow Gate
gates.about: A door to another world, and its lock.

gates.name: Isles Gate
gates.about: A door to another world, and its lock.

gates.about: A door to another world, and its lock.

gates.about: A door to another world, and its lock.

text.not_here: There is no gate within reach.
text.no_slot: There is no such rune slot.

text.guard_member: There is no such companion in the party.
text.refuse_fight: Not in the middle of a fight.
text.refuse_inside: The gate cannot be used from indoors.
text.refuse_up: The gate cannot be used from up there.
text.refuse_dark: The gate is dark. Its runes must be repaired first.
text.refuse_there: The gate at the other end is dark.
text.refuse_link: Those two gates are not on the same road.
text.refuse_charge: A flickering gate needs a charge: {n} {what}, and there is none.
text.refuse_clock: The world is not moving now.

text.charge_essence: The arch drinks an essence of {what}.
text.realm_out: {heir} steps back through the return gate.
text.realm_shut: The realm beyond is shut: the gate is dark.
text.panel_intro: {about} Runes of the old alphabet are cut round its ring and inlaid with silver. Lit, it carries {heir} to any other lit arch of its road.
